canada.title: Yukon conservation officers kill seven bears in first three weeks of October
canada.summary: The environment department says all but one of the bears was food-conditioned after getting into garbage.

canada.title: Winnipeg mayoral candidate Klein promises 2027 property-tax freeze, future hikes capped at 2.99%
canada.summary: Winnipeg mayoral candidate Kevin Klein clarified his fiscal policies on Friday as he promised to freeze property taxes in 2027 but also levy a new emergency-service fee equal to a 1.4 per cent property tax increase.

canada.title: YWCA Canada urges N.W.T. chapter to hold AGM amid governance concerns
canada.summary: YWCA Canada says the repeated postponing of the YWCA NWT’s annual general meeting (AGM) violates the northern chapter’s bylaws and risks eroding public trust.

canada.title: Regina youth faces threats charge after incident at high school
canada.summary: A 16-year-old girl is charged with uttering threats to another youth in connection to a school. School resource officers launched an investigation and were able to identify and locate the suspect, police said.

canada.title: Alberta introduces new flag rules and restrictions for all schools starting in 2027
canada.summary: The rules say school boards can apply for exemptions but only for flags that don't "constitute a political, social or ideological statement."

canada.title: Quebec woman who beat 4-year-old boy to death testifies in bid to get early parole
canada.summary: After 18 years behind bars, a Quebec woman who was found guilty of beating her then-boyfriend's four-year-old son to death in 2008 is appealing to a jury for a chance at early parole, saying she acknowledges and regrets what she did.

canada.title: Ottawa police suspend use of Crime Stoppers after data breach uncovered
canada.summary: The Ottawa Police Service says it is suspending its use of Crime Stoppers after an exclusive CBC News investigation revealed the extent of a massive data leak.
canada.outlet: CBC News, Global News, Ottawa Citizen

canada.title: New tentative agreement announced for some Sask. health-care workers
canada.summary: The Saskatchewan Government and General Employees' Union (SGEU) has reached a tentative agreement with the government for up to 2,040 health-care staff in central and northern Saskatchewan.

canada.title: Manitoba government drops plan to limit new autism strategy to children
canada.summary: The Manitoba government is withdrawing amendments to a Liberal MLA's bill that would have made a new provincial autism strategy only apply to children.

canada.title: Canadian woman dies in U.S. over fear of crossing through B.C. for medical care
canada.summary: A U.S. immigration lawyer says his Canadian client died after failing to seek medical care over fears she would be detained and deported by U.S. authorities.

canada.title: Regis Korchinski-Paquet's mother shown security footage at inquest into high-rise death
canada.summary: Regis Korchinski-Paquet's mother was shown snippets of security footage from the day her daughter died as she resumed her testimony at a coroner's inquest after making a new allegation against police involved in the case.

canada.title: Power outage that affected roughly 2,000 customers in St. John's now resolved
canada.summary: Newfoundland Power's site shows no more outages in the centre city area of St. John's Friday evening, after an early evening notice of more than 2,000 homes and businesses without power.

canada.title: 2 new charges laid against man accused in Halifax U.S. consulate bomb threat
canada.summary: Halifax police have laid two more charges against a man following a bomb threat at the United States consulate in August.

canada.title: Hampstead, Que., mayor pleads guilty, faces $30K fine after anti-Palestine posts
canada.summary: Hampstead Mayor Jeremy Levi pleaded guilty to a professional ethics breach and faces a $30,000 fine over comments he made about Palestine.

canada.title: Redesign of infamous Saint John corner considered highlight of $463M port expansion funding
canada.summary: A $463 million expansion of the Saint John port will include a notoriously complicated intersection that city officials have struggled to address for decades.

canada.title: U.S. price-fixing case advances against Canadian frozen potato giants
canada.summary: New Brunswick’s McCain Foods Limited and J.D. Irving-owned Cavendish Farms were among five defendants seeking the case’s dismissal.

canada.title: Advocates point to contributions, not costs, of newcomers in Alberta referendum aftermath
canada.summary: A union representative for a beef processing plant south of Calgary is warning of worsening labour shortages if immigration policy proposals that narrowly passed in Alberta's referendum are enacted.

canada.title: What you need to know about B.C. party platforms ahead of Saturday's election
canada.summary: B.C.'s five top parties have released campaign platforms intended to sway voters on their vision for the future of the province.
